description: Apply a follow-up edit prompt to a project (creates a new version; an edit that changes nothing is free). Spends credits (depends on `tier`, default standard). Spends credits, so it is two-step: this call returns needs_confirmation with the price and a confirmToken; show the summary to the user, then call confirm_action with the token to run it. Counts against this connection's daily credit cap.

tier.description: Model tier, default standard. fast: a small model, 6 credits a build / 3 a change, apps and games only, simpler results; standard: Claude Sonnet, 21 / 10; best: Claude Opus, 81 / 40, slower.
